Vacatia Preview CenterPest Sight Log  |  Quick Reference
How to Use This Log
Staff Instructions:
  1. When a pest is observed, record the sighting in the next available row on the current log sheet.
  2. Use the Pest Code table below to identify the pest type. If unsure, describe it in the Notes column.
  3. Record the date, location, and your initials.
  4. Notify the property manager or maintenance supervisor immediately for active infestations.
  5. Do not apply any pest control products — contact Pest Pro directly: (407) 922-2276.
Pest Code Reference

Use the codes below when completing sighting log entries.

CodePestCommon IndicatorsPriority
Code AAntsTrails, nest activity, mounds near entry pointsStandard
Code BBed BugsBlood spots, shed skins, odor in guest roomsHIGH — Notify immediately
Code FFlies / GnatsClusters near drains, food areas, or wasteStandard
Code MMosquitoesStanding water, biting activity, larvae in waterStandard
Code RRoachesEgg casings, droppings, odor, live sightingsHIGH — Notify immediately
Code RoRodentsDroppings, gnaw marks, nesting materials, tracksHIGH — Notify immediately
Code SSpidersWebs, live sightings, egg sacsStandard
Code WWasps / BeesNests, swarms, stinging activityHIGH — Do not disturb
Code OOtherDescribe in Notes columnPer assessment
